noise_policy: Stability improvement bypasses the mean gate. Same-steady latency-based acceptance requires >=5% workload-weighted mean gain; P95 cannot bypass the gate. Memory-only ties retain the Module 3A rule. Std is recorded, not used in a significance test.
aggregation: Worst stability across all three runs; equal-weight repetition mean; sample std ddof=1. Never discard failed repetitions. Missing aggregate mean/P95 if any repeat lacks it.
launch_policy: Sequential; no retries or replacement candidates. Persistent reservations count toward budget.
